title: Consistency Report v1.0
description: Schema for a single consistency-check report — emitted by the consistency_check tool after every Excel transaction checkpoint (§9.4 L6) and on demand. Merges two rule sets: (a) 20 Cross-Sheet Rules (CSR-F-01..15, CSR-D-01..03, CSR-M-01..02) defined in cross-sheet-invariants.json, and (b) 8 Critical Invariants (CI-01..08) defined in §17.2. Verdict aggregation per §17.2: any RED → RED; else any AMBER/WARN → AMBER; all PASS → GREEN. Enums are inline at each property path for direct readability.

run_id.description: Links to provenance-log.run_id that triggered this check (when applicable).

verdict.description: Top-level roll-up per §17.2. RED = block the transaction. AMBER = warn, manual review suggested. GREEN = all clear.

checks.description: One entry per evaluated rule (CSR or CI). Empty array means no rules ran (also invalid — verdict must reflect at least one check).

check_id.description: Rule identifier. CSR-F-NN / CSR-D-NN / CSR-M-NN (from cross-sheet-invariants.json) or CI-NN (§17.2). Free-form for infrastructural invariants.

category.description: Eight categories cover every invariant the plugin enforces. csr_foundation/csr_data/csr_mcp map to cross-sheet-invariants.json rule categories. The remaining five are infrastructural invariants (row counts, hashes, URL canonicalization, schema instance validation, staging vs Excel diffs).

verdict.description: Per-check outcome. PASS/WARN/FAIL map to the top-level GREEN/AMBER/RED via §17.2 aggregation.

severity.description: Rule's declared severity (from cross-sheet-invariants.json or §17.2). CRITICAL/HIGH→RED on FAIL, MEDIUM/LOW→AMBER on FAIL.

rule.description: Formal rule body, copied verbatim from the source-of-truth (cross-sheet-invariants.json rule field, or §17.2 table).

expected.description: Reference value the check compared against. Untyped — may be integer, string, array, object per check nature.

actual.description: Observed value from the workbook/staging. Untyped — see expected.

auto_repair_available.description: Whether §9.3 lists this check as auto-repairable. Does NOT mean it was repaired — see repair_applied.

repair_applied.description: True when the tool actually performed the repair. Also recorded in top-level auto_repair_performed.

affected_rows.description: For set-membership CSRs — size of the violating subset.

sample_violations.description: Up to 20 sample values that violate the rule. Truncated so the report stays bounded.

by_category.description: Roll-up per category — keys are the 8 category enum values.

auto_repair_performed.description: List of check_ids for which an auto-repair (§9.3) was successfully applied during this run. Corresponding check entries should also have repair_applied=true.

manual_review_required.description: List of check_ids requiring human decision per §9.3 (F-06, F-15, D-01 confirm).
